description: For distinct atoms a and b, replacing a by b and then replacing b by a sends the implication from a to b to the implication from a to a.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.subst_sequential_imp.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (a b : α) (hab : a ≠ b) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.subst
      (fun c =>
        if c = b then Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a
        else Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom c)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.subst
        (fun c =>
          if c = a then Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom b
          else Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom c)
        ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a).impl (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom b))) =
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a).impl (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.atom a)
